business_problem: Loopit needed to remove the programming barrier that kept most users from becoming creators, so it could turn idea descriptions into playable mini apps quickly enough to drive creativity, remixing, and user engagement at scale.
solution_summary: Loopit built its content-creation agent on Google Cloud so users can generate interactive mini apps, games, memes, and digital toys without writing code. The experience is driven by the Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, which together handle user conversation, tool calling, code generation, and material creation for one-to-five-minute build cycles. Gemini 3.0 Pro delivered the quality and aesthetic control Loopit needed during evaluation, while the production platform later split workloads between Gemini 3 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash so simpler builds can complete in one to two minutes and more complex requests still have enough model depth. Multimodal support lets creators use photos and videos as references, and the agent remains flexible instead of forcing everyone through a fixed workflow. This architecture lowers the technical barrier to creation, encourages remix culture, and gives Loopit a scalable foundation for fast-growing interactive content.

data_flow: Users describe an idea or provide photos and videos as references, Loopit's Gemini-powered agent turns that intent into code and assets through the Gemini API and agent platform, and the resulting mini app is returned in minutes so users can play, remix, and share it immediately.
business_outcome: Loopit made mini-app creation possible within minutes for non-programmers, improved engagement through remix-friendly interactive content, and reached more than one million downloads only two months after launch.
